name: mirage
text: Profitable so far, on a small sample. Of the engine's 681 live orders (479 bids, 202 bets), 330 have settled. Bids: 258 settled, 133 won and 125 lost, +$19.42 on $181 staked (+10.7%). Bets: 72 settled, 38 won and 34 lost, +$7.98 on $87 staked (+9.2%). Together that is about +$27 profit. Caveat: the engine quoted an average edge of only about 3-4%, so +10% is above what the edge predicts. With 330 bets that is mostly luck, and the true return is probably nearer 3-4%. Also, 351 orders are still open or unsettled. Right now 758 bids are resting ($342). The bet side placed nothing on the latest pass because it already holds those markets and few bets have a sharp book confirming them. I'll check the closing-line value (CLV) numbers next, since that is a better test than results at this size.
